translations.web: By faith, he kept the Passover, and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.
translations.bsb: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of blood, so that the destroyer of the firstborn would not touch Israel’s own firstborn.
translations.kjv: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.
translations.asv: By faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.
